bl-obsessed-with-him-surrendered-to-his-:
Which part of my life is funnier?
The part where my own family sold me off to an older man like a piece of property, and I ran away just so I wouldn’t lose my virginity… or the part where I ended up losing it anyway to a billionaire inside his private jet, high up in the sky?
Less than twenty-four hours ago, I was nothing more than a pawn. For the first time in nineteen years, my parents took me on a family vacation. I actually thought they were finally treating me like their real son.
I was wrong.
Two hours before our flight home, my father sold me to a man three times my age to save his failing company. They slipped something into my drink, handed me over, and flew home without me. I woke up alone in a foreign hotel room with a complete stranger sitting across from me. I had never seen him before, and I had no idea who he was.
My desperate escape led me straight into the path of Frederick Corvin, a powerful billionaire seventeen years older than me.
He saved me, but I paid the price with my body on his private jet. I told myself I didn’t mind. I wanted us to be even so I wouldn’t owe him anything. But after we landed, Frederick didn’t just walk away. He kept coming back.…

dimensional-tycoon-i-make-trillions-in-e:
Noa’s life turned into a disaster.
He was fired for no reason, betrayed by the woman he loved, and left drowning in debt for a wedding that would never happen.
Then a truck almost killed him.
And just before the world went black—time froze.
Suddenly, Noa is no longer an average human—he is a Dimensional Tycoon, capable of buying and selling planets at market price.
When gods need immortality, Noa sells them elixirs. When demon kings want weapons of mass destruction, they pay in cash. When heavens fall, he buys the land. When empires collapse, he auctions the ashes.
Noa can trade anything, as long as the price is fair.
He doesn’t conquer realms, because in this world, money is the greatest power—and Noa controls the market.
After all, even divine beings knock on his door—not to fight, but to ask for a discount.
But every tycoon has to start somewhere.
For Noa, it began with selling shampoo to bald cultivators.

The girl he wanted to destroy becomes the woman he can’t stop watching. Touching. Needing.

Zhang Feng, as a powerful mentor destined to become the next generation Celestial Master, encountered a mishap during the Celestial Master transition ceremony and found himself traversed into this world.
Upon opening his eyes, he discovered he had become a forensic scientist and was immediately tasked to perform an autopsy to determine the victim’s cause of death.
Zhang Feng expressed his utter breakdown:
“I don’t know anything about performing autopsies! What do I do now?”
Holding a scalpel, Zhang Feng looked at the pale corpse before him:

Su Zhou was a natural-born superhuman. To him, crushing bones was as effortless as crumbling butter cookies.
Sometimes, being too special isn’t exactly a good thing. For many years, he searched this seemingly ordinary world for others of his kind, but his efforts always ended in vain…
That was, until the sudden advent of the Spiritual Revival drew back the curtain on a vast, magnificent new era.
In a world now teeming with monsters, wicked fiends, and countless demonic entities—
Within a multiverse teetering on the brink of shattering and on the eve of absolute destruction—

Drawing his blade in the face of injustice, he has but one rule:
“Any monster that dares to appear before him… must die!”
my-first-love-died-now-my-step-uncle-wan:
She is an orphan with no blood ties to him, calling him 'young uncle', yet he regards her as his possession.
He is the heir to a powerful family, the all-powerful Crown Prince of Elysian City, yet for her, he lays an inescapable trap, meticulously plotting every move.
From the moment she stepped into the Rhodes Family ten years ago, her fate was already sealed.
When she is bullied and seeks revenge, he impassively indulges her in her vengeance.
Having been alone since childhood, she yearns for affection; he weaves a web of love, letting her fall and lose herself within it.
Little did he expect that one day, his possession would escape his control...
The person she loves is someone else!
He transforms into a demon, cornering her, “Nina Wynn, you dare to love someone else?”
Nina Wynn dares not look him in the eye, “You are my nominal young uncle, I dare not love you.”
He presses closer, “Is it 'don't want to' or 'don't dare'?”
———

on-the-path-of-eternal-strength:
“On the Path of Eternal Strength”
Sebastián lost everything when he was just a child: his mother, his home, his world. Thrown into a savage land, where monsters and death lurk in every shadow, he learned to survive. For ten years, every breath was a struggle, every step a battle.
But one day, survival was no longer enough.
Driven by a deeper longing, Sebastián decides to walk a different path: one of absolute perfection, where body, mind, and spirit are forged through martial arts and constant self-improvement.
In a universe where power is everything, Sebastián will not fight merely to live—he will live to reach Eternal Strength.
His journey will not be easy. Pain, betrayal, and glory will be his companions.
This is not just a road to the top…
It is the story of a soul that chose to transcend its limits.

Somebody once told a joke.
A man ran in place all his life. He worked a job he didn't love for people he couldn't stand. But at the end of the day, the number in his bank account went up.
That man got a second chance at life. He woke up in another world, full of adventures and romances and monsters and gods. And floating above his head he saw the number “1”.
So what did he say?
“Gosh I better make the number go up.”
Not today. Not for this old soul. Reborn as a beast of battle meant to live a short life and die screaming, Garek refuses. He puts the madness of skills and levels behind him and sets out to found a little farmstead. He grows crops. Maybe someday he'll get a pig, and have bacon.
It's a shame the world won't let him be. It's a shame that the warmongers and level-grinders hate nothing more than a soul at peace.
He put down his sword for a plowshare, but when trouble comes calling, he'll pick it up again.

Instead of being placed in one of the seven civilizations, safe zones meant to protect people from the terrifying abominations.…
sss-class-profession-the-path-to-mastery:
In a world where every profession has its own system, one's fate is determined by the job they awaken. Reynard Vale was cursed with the weakest profession—Unskilled Laborer—a dead-end path with no future. Mocked, powerless, and abandoned, he saw no way out.
But on the night he chose to end it all, the system intervened.
[Congratulations! You have awakened the hidden profession: Jobmaster (SSS-Class)!]
Now, with the ability to learn, switch, and master any profession, Reynard is no longer bound by limitations. From boxer to librarian, investigator to world leader—every skill, every class, and every power is his to wield.
The world that once looked down on him will soon bow before the ultimate professional.
starting-cultivation-during-a-trip:
Zhang Fan, a university graduate, is on a sightseeing tour the day the Jade Scroll Transmission is conducted at the Zhenwu Mountain.
The Ancestral Master once prophesized: 'The Zhenwu lineage will be passed for seventy-three generations, and due to Ordinary Tribulation, descendants will emerge.'
“Neither absolute nor extinct, there will be a pause at the seventy-third generation...”
“The lineage of True Martial Mountain has reached the seventy-third generation today, is the heavenly mandate coming to an end?”
surviving-restructuring:
The moment I received the restructuring notice from my company, the world changed with a deafening roar, as if the sky was collapsing.
[The sale of this Earth has been decided.] [Restructuring of personnel will be carried out.]
A life-or-death restructuring. Missions that grant special powers upon completion. If this is some miraculous prank, I’ll give it my all!
“I found it. A way for us all to survive.”
The meteoric rise of Lee Eunho, the restructuring target, begins now!
the-famous-millionaire:
Miracles don’t come walking your way by themselves.
It is your decisions and will that determine these.
A story of a man who created miracles.
the-infernal-knights-revenge:
I was a Royal Knight once.
A dutiful one. I upheld the twelve Chivalric virtues.
I served my King. I defended my Kingdom.
For what?
To be the sacrifice of a hellish ritual? Betrayed by the people I swore an oath to?
I was cast into Hell as payment for a bargain I was never even made aware of.
Decades, centuries, an endless blur of pain, chase, and torture.
What was an eternity for me was mere months for them.
Now I am back from Hell. Through a bargain of my own.
Another oath sworn. Another chance.
For what?
I serve my Queen. I defend her hellish Kingdom.
My revenge. Against the twelve bastards who wronged me.
I am an Infernal Knight now.
the-invincible-strongest-student:
A conspiracy brings unexpected gains to Lin Tian. He finds a golden orb in his stomach and gains the ability to see through things. However, the sudden departure of his girlfriend makes his heart broken and he swears:
“Today you abandon me and leave, I will make you regretful in the future.”
the-luna-you-betrayed-is-no-longer-yours:
“This is Virella… my wife.”
Three years.
And that was all Alpha Kaelen gave me.
No welcome.
No touch.
No recognition.
Just another woman at his side—carrying his child.
While I ruled in his absence… I was nothing more than a placeholder.
A Luna he never chose.
So I gave up.
And I left.
One rejection was all it took to break the bond.
When I returned, I wasn’t the Luna he abandoned.
I was untouchable, respected, and feared.
And no longer his to claim.
Now he watches me like a man drowning….
Because the woman he discarded came back as something far beyond his reach.
And this time… I didn’t come alone.
The Alpha of Ebonmoon stands beside me, his presence crushing, and his hand firm on my waist….
“Careful, Kaelen,” his voice drops, dark with warning.
“Rowena isn’t yours anymore.”
His lips brush my temple, possessively.
“She’s mine. If you try to take her…I’ll end you.”
the-mafia-empire:
The Mafia Empire tells the story of Julian Kesma, the third son of a poor farmer’s family in a decaying empire. After gaining memories from his past life as a shrewd businessman from Earth, Julian sets out on a dangerous journey to climb from the bottom of society to its very top. Battling poverty and social discrimination, he forms a gang from his fellow oppressed Guarths and dives into the criminal underworld, quickly becoming entangled in deadly political conspiracies.
Through cunning, ruthless tactics, and a cold, calculating nature, Julian transforms from a struggling nobody into a fearsome mafia lord. As he gains influence in both the underworld and legitimate businesses, he manipulates his way into the political arena, aiming to dominate every aspect of society. His ambition extends far beyond crime, as he strives to reshape the empire itself.
transmigrated-into-an-eroge-conquering-h:
In a world so bleak that civilization relies on eroge to survive the daily slog, trashy porn games aren’t just disappointing, they’re a crime against humanity.
Enter Ryan Tate. At twenty-one, he’s a broke, unhinged game reviewer who has turned the public destruction of garbage eroges into a sacred art.
To millions of burnt-out players, he isn't just a reviewer; he’s a legendary hero purging the digital landscape of brain-dead plots and dense protagonists.
When Ryan gets into an all-out forum war over the terrible writing of the newly released Eroge Online, he makes one thing clear: he could run this game a thousand times better.
The universe takes him up on it—!
Waking up inside Eroge Online, Ryan finds himself trapped in the digital skin of Yaze Orpheus, the single most useless, dense protagonist in gaming history.
To make matters worse, a divine troll calling itself the God of Bets slaps him with an unskippable bet:
[WAGER: Speed-run the plot, conquer every heroine, and force a True Ending.]
[STAKES: Clear the game to return home. Fail, and face instant, excruciating death.]
A lesser man would panic.…
triple-blessings-mr-fus-passionate-pursu:
Critically ill, Master Fu reluctantly called for a miracle doctor. Not only was the miracle doctor highly skilled in medicine, she also managed to soothe Master Fu’s hot-tempered son.
One day, the young master had a serious expression on his face as he said, “Daddy, I want Dr. Liu to be my Mommy!”
This enraged Master Fu. How dare this woman have the audacity to try and get to him through his son?
He angrily shoved a check at Liu Muqiu and told her to get lost. Liu Muqiu took the check and swiftly left with the young boy. Master Fu chased after them for miles only to discover that this woman had not only taken away his precious son, but had also been hiding his two other little darlings!
Master Fu decided to take decisive action and bundled the whole lot back home. That infuriating Liu Muqiu was also brought back home alongside them.
Since he couldn’t scold or punish this woman, he decided to dote on her instead!
vampire-nightlife:
“Meet. Befriend. Seduce.”
Those were the words promised which made him excited.
“Play Nightlife and date your favorite Vampire Girlfriend!”
—-—-
When Lukas purchases Nightlife, all he expected was dating all the girls and getting the sweet sweet “plot”. He didn't expect to be thrown into the world entirely!
What's a Vampire got to do to survive?
